summary: Railcare Group AB (publ) provides railway maintenance services in Sweden. It operates through Contracting, Transport, and Technology segments. The company offers railvac, ballast feeder, snow, and custom-built machines; and transport services, including freight, special, and contractor transport services. It also provides work shop services for extending service life of locomotives and machines, electric and battery power, ETCS and radio control, maintenance and overhaul, and automation and installation. In addition, the company offers contracting services for ballast replacement in switches, bridges, and straight tracks; cable management; drainage measures and culvert renovation; vegetation removal; and snow clearence. Railcare Group AB (publ) was founded in 1992 and is based in Skelleftehamn, Sweden.
